items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: And then I went back to L.A. and Shelly Manne opened his club, called The Manne-Hole. And I worked there for about two or three years.

ctx.x: Yeah, your name is definitely associated with the west coast.

Pretty much. As you know, like all of us, Shelly Manne, Shorty Rogers, Jimmy Giuffre, Neil Bernhardt, Gerry Mulligan, Chet Baker. None of us are from California. Yet we play the west coast jazz. I think the media just put that hype on us.
I have a picture here that you might recall.
